title: MA30007: Computer Software
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Prerequisite: voidPositional Value system, binary and hexadecimal
representation, BCD arithmetic, 2s complement representation and arithmetic,
Boolean algebra and switching Theory, error correcting code, grey codes, prefix
and postfix expressions. Priority and circular queue, hashing, link list,
height balanced tree, B-tree. Algorithms: Backtracking, branch and bound,
complexity of algorithms, P, NP, NPC problems, lower bound theory. Random
number and simulation, problems in combinatorics. Introduction to assembly
languages, lambda expressions and fixed point.
